items.title: Anthropic raises $65B Series H at $965B valuation
items.summary: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital.

items.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.8
items.summary: Claude Opus 4.8 brings stronger performance across coding, agentic tasks, and professional work, and the consistency to handle long-running work.
items.summaryZh: 隆重推出 Claude Opus 4.8。我们正在将 Claude Opus 升级到新版本：Claude Opus 4.8。它基于 Opus 4.7 构建，在基准测试中进行了改进，是一个更有效的协作者。
